parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If your instance has an ID, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If your instance does not have an ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
